<includeonly>{{#if:{{{link|{{{1|}}}}}}
| {{#if:{{#pos:{{{link|{{{1|}}}}}}|<nowiki/>://}}{{#pos:{{{link|{{{1|}}}}}}|mailto:}}
	| {{Link/External|link= {{{link|{{{1}}}}}}|text= {{{text|{{{2|}}}}}}}}
	| {{Link/Internal|link= {{{link|{{{1}}}}}}|text= {{{text|{{{2|}}}}}}}}
}}
| -no link provided-{{TemplateCase||[[Category:Link template usage error]]}}
}}</includeonly><noinclude>{{Doc/Template

|descr= This template combines {{Template|Link/External}} and {{Template|Link/Internal}} under one entrypoint.
It also adds the page to the [[:Category:Link template usage error|Link template usage error]] category on usage error.

|param1= link
|descr1= (possibly named parameter) the URL or the local link, hashed or not ({{hl|Operation Flashpoint#Introduction}})

|param2= text
|descr2= (Optional, possibly named parameter) text to be displayed

|example1= <nowiki/>
<nowiki>* {{Link}}</nowiki>
|result1= <nowiki/>
* {{Link}}

|example2= <nowiki/>
<nowiki>* {{Link|http://}}</nowiki><br>
<nowiki>* {{Link|https://}}</nowiki><br>
<nowiki>* {{Link|ftp://}}</nowiki><br>
<nowiki>* {{Link|enfusion://}}</nowiki><br>
<nowiki>* {{Link|armareforger://}}</nowiki><br>
<nowiki>* {{Link|steam://}}</nowiki><br>
<nowiki>* {{Link|mailto:}}</nowiki>
|result2= <nowiki/>

* {{Link|https://}}
* {{Link|ftp://}}
* {{Link|enfusion://}}
* {{Link|armareforger://}}
* {{Link|steam://}}
* {{Link|mailto:}}
